newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC BLASTS THROUGH TO LAST 16.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-IVANISEVIC BLASTS THROUGH TO LAST 16.

text.p: Croatian big-hitter Goran Ivanisevic hammered his way into the fourth round of the Australian Open on Saturday, beating American Chris Woodruff 6-3 6-7 6-3 6-1.
The Croat, seeded number three and ranked four in the world, took two hours and 38 minutes to dispose of his 42nd ranked opponent, producing 26 aces along the way.
Ivanisevic will play unseeded Norwegian Christian Ruud in the next round. Ruud beat South African Neville Godwin in another third-round tie.
